subject: general
question: The objective of the 'Sagarmala Project' is to:

options.text: reduce logistics cost for domestic cargo and EXIM cargo
install equipment for gas and oil exploration

solution:
The correct answer is to __**reduce logistics costs for domestic cargo and EXIM cargo**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The** Sagarmala Project is an initiative by the Government of India aimed at promoting port-led development in the country. **
 
• The **Sagarmala Project** is a strategic initiative launched by the Government of India in 2015, aimed at transforming India’s logistics sector through port-led development.
 
• It seeks to leverage India’s 7,500 km coastline and maritime assets for economic growth
 
• The** key objectives of the project:**
 
 
• Enhancing Port Connectivity: Improve the infrastructure and connectivity to ports to facilitate the smooth movement of goods.
 
• Reducing Logistics Costs:
 
 
• The project focuses on reducing the logistics cost for both domestic cargo and Export-Import (EXIM) cargo, making Indian exports more competitive globally.
 
 
 
• Port Modernization: Modernizing existing ports and developing new ports to accommodate larger vessels and improve operational efficiency.
 
• Coastal Economic Zones: Developing coastal economic zones and promoting industries along the coastline to create jobs and boost the economy.
